items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999
items.q: So he came to me he says, “hey Marty, would you like to sit in with the band?”

ctx.x: Teddy, yeah. That’s a funny story too, because I was working at Childs’ Paramount with Henry Jerome’s band. And there was a — oh a little ginger ale does it — and there was a club on Fifth Avenue and 43rd Street, called The 400 Club. And I was working with Henry up there, at 42nd Street and Broadway, and after the job I went to see Krupa’s band because I knew they were working at this club. And when I walked in, the band, I don’t know whether they had just taken a break or they had played the last number,…
Yeah, we were talking about Krupa, this was 1945.
